verdicts.reason: A has no consistent alignment: the GROVE wordmark is centred, the headline and body copy are left-aligned, and the badges and CTA are pushed to the right. The badges nearly touch, and the text block drifts off any shared edge. B sits on a clean left grid with a full-width CTA, but it has its own flaws. GROVE is blown up until it competes with the headline, and 'back' is left alone on the headline's last line. The FREE DELIVERY badge has been dropped below the CTA, crammed near the bottom edge, which makes it look like an afterthought. The shoe also sits high inside its circle, leaving the bottom of the circle empty.
